description: This file defines a C# class 'Cookies' that provides methods to interact with browser cookies via JavaScript interop, including delete and get cookie functionalities.

classes.name: Cookies
classes.description: A class that provides asynchronous methods for deleting and retrieving cookies using JavaScript interop.

methods.name: DeleteCookie
methods.description: Deletes a cookie with the specified name using JavaScript interop.

methods.name: GetCookie
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a cookie with the specified name asynchronously.
